description: This file defines a CalculatorService class extending a Service class, which registers 'add' and 'sub' methods for calculation. It also initializes a ServiceManager, opens a connection, and registers the CalculatorService instance.

classes.name: CalculatorService
classes.description: A service class providing basic calculator operations 'add' and 'sub'.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Calculates the sum of an array of numbers provided in params.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Calculates the difference between the first two numbers in params.
